evidence.r1: Transport, volume and queue actions are glass; Playing Next is an opaque content panel in both schemes.
evidence.r2: Playlist menu replaces Save Queue and uses an outline rather than nested glass for focus in both schemes.
evidence.r3: Three glass groups provide transport, volume and queue saving in both schemes.
evidence.r4: Transport, volume and playlist menu share a frosted appearance in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear glass is visible; transport is frosted over ice artwork in both schemes.
evidence.r6: Transport and queue controls remain neutral without competing tints in both schemes.
evidence.r7: Light transport and playlist menu carry blurred ice colours rather than flat replacement backgrounds.
evidence.r8: Transport and volume are capsules; playlist and queue panels use fixed corners in both schemes.
evidence.r9: Light playlist focus outline has a reduced radius and even inset inside the menu.
evidence.r10: Save Queue is capsule-shaped and dense playlist options are rounded within the menu in both schemes.
evidence.r11: Transport shares one surface while volume and queue saving form separate purposeful groups in both schemes.
evidence.r12: Transport has icon buttons only; Save Queue is one labelled control, not a shared text/icon-button group, in both schemes.
evidence.r13: Transport material surrounds the complete control bar rather than individual icons in both schemes.
evidence.r14: Lower transport and volume maintain a deliberate wide gap with matching material in both schemes.
evidence.r15: No scroll-edge treatment is visible near lower transport or upper queue in either scheme.
evidence.r16: Detailed ice artwork lies beneath transport, volume and playlist menu in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Ice artwork continues directly beneath lower controls at rest in both schemes.
evidence.r18: Dark transport timestamps are pale on grey material; exact small-text contrast is not established.
evidence.r19: Light reduced Save Queue label drops against the bottom of its pill, and motion/contrast modes are not shown.
evidence.r20: Album artwork reaches every window edge behind floating lower controls in both schemes.
evidence.r21: Lower controls overlay artwork without demonstrated safe-area clearing or sidebar extension in either scheme.
evidence.r22: Transport, volume and playlist popup float without an additional backing strip in both schemes.
evidence.r23: Playlist endpoint captures do not demonstrate morphing or press feedback in either scheme.
evidence.r24: Transport, volume and playlist labels are monochrome in both schemes.
evidence.r25: Control labels remain dark on pale material or pale on grey, rather than taking ice-blue hues in either scheme.
